subject: learning/code-pyxis-startup-worktree-harnesses
statement: The startup config copy requires a real destination .pyxis directory and an absent config.local.yaml path. Repository-controlled symlinks, dangling links, files, or directories cannot redirect or receive machine-local configuration. Rejected destinations and copy failures stop launch and clean up only the newly created worktree and branch.
intent: Prevent fetched repository paths from redirecting local configuration into other files, and avoid abandoned worktrees on failed launches.
rationale: PR 1181 review identified that cp -p follows pre-existing destination symlinks after worktree checkout and that the failure return left the new worktree and branch behind.
learned_from: PR 1181 P1 and P2 review; real Git and terminal race tests cover nine unsafe destinations, unchanged external files, dangling targets, repeated copy failures, and preservation of existing worktrees.

provenance.note: Repoints unchanged knowledge to scripts/startup after the launcher moved there from script/startup.
